company_name: Clear Sky Creations, LLC (brand name "Clear Sky"; sub-brands Clear Sky Sports and Clear Sky Beauty exist; "Directed By Cameron" is Cameron's personal brand)
tagline: "Content unmatched" (the Northstar example for the Stapelia Hirsuta Script accent; it also closes the Playbook values line "We won't stop until we give our clients what they deserve, content unmatched"). Other approved lines: "Tell the truth beautifully." (Directed By Cameron/CSC One Pager power phrase), "Strategic Storytellers", "Premium Branding for Premium Business", "Build your Brand" (Clear Sky Portal One Pager key phrases). User-requested homepage line for the replaced section: "We make content creation a breeze."
positioning: Playbook one-sentence positioning: "Businesses struggle with being known, gaining trust, and separating themselves from the competition. Through organic social media and brand positioning, Clear Sky Creations helps you accomplish all three." Supporting messaging (DBC/CSC One Pager, Aug 2026): "You do not need louder content. You need a clearer story. Clear Sky helps brands tell the truth beautifully through video, content strategy, creative direction, and ethical marketing systems." Website proof line used in current copy drafts (Clear Sky About Us Feature doc and Portal One Pager): "Our clients average 4x more impressions in three months, which means cheaper ads, pre-sold leads, and real room to scale." (verify before publishing). Mission (Playbook): "We help brands who are an agent for positive change in the world, as well as the ethically-sound people who run them, grow with great content." Vision: "We see a future where the businesses we help grow and the content we produce improve people's lives." Identity: "We like to have fun while we optimize, produce, and leverage creative ideas." Three active ICPs: medium-sized multi-location service businesses ($1M to $10M), funded startups (Seed to Series B), and marketing agencies lacking production support. Competitive edge (Portal One Pager): story-first strategy built on the founder's real story; values-driven partnership with transparent process; premium quality with AI-automated workflows ("Creatives create, AI automates.").

voice_rules: Overall: simple, lighthearted, fun but professional, confident, grounded. Human to human. If Cameron read it aloud it should sound like him talking to a friend who happens to be a client.

Website and email tone (Clear Sky Portal One Pager): clear, confident, conversational copy; story-driven About pages; benefit-first CTAs without hype or false urgency. Inform and invite, never pressure.
Lead with the point, then add context. Keep it short. Every line must carry a real claim or a real move; cut transitional fluff.
ABSOLUTE: no em-dashes anywhere on the site. Use periods, commas, or a new sentence.
Banned constructions: 'X instead of (opposite)'; 'no X, no Y, just Z'; 'we promote X, not Y'; assert-then-negate-the-inverse ('Do this. Not that.'). No redundant phrasing, no filler adjectives.

No words chosen to sound smart: avoid 'leverage synergies', 'circle back', 'bandwidth', 'game-changer', 'take it to the next level', 'growth hacking', 'synergy', 'hacks', 'content factory', 'cheap', guaranteed or viral promises, fear-based urgency, guru or hype-marketer energy.

Power words (Portal One Pager): Experienced, Premium, Value, Authenticity, Integrity, Partner. Key phrases: 'Build your Brand', 'Creatives create, AI automates.', 'Premium Branding for Premium Business', 'Get un-stuck', 'Strategic Storytellers', 'Tell the truth beautifully', 'Proof over claims'.
Warm, specific enthusiasm. Exclamation points are the default warm punctuation in client-facing CTAs ('Let me know!', 'Reach out to Clear Sky today!').
Faith shows up grounded, never preachy: honest, humble, invitational. Values in action, not a costume.
Never talk poorly about competitors. Never overhype; let the work and case studies sell (grounded confidence).
Second person, present tense, contractions. Talk like one person to one person.
Signature/footer standard: 'Clear Sky Creations // www.clearskycreations.com'. Email signature: 'Cameron Bennett / Owner // www.clearskycreations.com'.

Visual-voice rules from Northstar: light blue and light yellow support, never lead; script font is a flourish only; dark blue logo on light backgrounds, white logo on dark/photo backgrounds; mustard rule in footer.
services: Consulting & Strategy (pre-production): brand voice creation, social media consultation, 30-min meeting with Cameron, social strategy (16-idea minimum), production planning, project management, creative direction, producing, copywriting

Production: full crew video production (director, producer, cinematography, 2-ton lighting kit, grips, gaffers, hair/makeup, locations). Packages: Social, Prime, Curated, Spotlight, Campaign, Event (add-on, not primary), Remote, Studio, Real Estate. Photography (headshots, facility, lifestyle, event) via partners
Social Media Management: content days (shoot, edit, deliver) and content retainers (shoot, edit, and post on the client's behalf), often hybrid
Paid Media / Marketing: Meta and Google ad management, design and concept newsletters, drip email campaigns
Post-Production: 4 edit tiers up to motion graphics; hero videos, short-form ads, testimonials, VSLs, website landers, sizzle/process videos, cutdowns, social reels, color, photo retouching
Design & Web: logo creation, brand guidelines, landing/conversion pages, website launch and copy, e-commerce setup

Packaged offerings: CS Academy Program, CS Social Coaching, CS Strategy, CS Social (monthly full social retainer), CS Core (6-month hero package), CS Social + Core, CS Complete, CS Remote, Local by Clear Sky, CS Web Dev, CS Staffing
Ruled out (do not list on site): live events as primary offering, live broadcasting, weddings, music videos, films, internal-only communications work

about.founder: Cameron Bennett, Owner & Creative Director (strategist, lead creative, lead salesperson and pitch developer). Personal brand: Directed By Cameron.
about.story: Cameron studied video production and filmmaking. Out of college he built an Instagram account doing baseball content ('Baseball Bro', grew to about 50K followers during COVID per the Clear Sky Portal One Pager), found organic success, and got obsessed with what makes people stop scrolling. When COVID hit and digital became mandatory for businesses, he launched Clear Sky Creations. The business is built on doing what is needed to bring light into the world, not on 'more, more, more.' As a man of faith, Cameron runs CSC so his work reflects the same principles he holds in his faith, which is why CSC takes on projects that matter and refuses to keep clients happy with empty promises. Values (Playbook): integrity, honesty, diligence, and quality, 'content unmatched.' Alternate values set (Portal One Pager, Aug 2026): Transparency, Integrity, Selflessness, Love, Focus. Stands for justice, ethics, selflessness, hard work that earns respect, understanding before solving. Editorial principles: raw, story-driven editing; emotional and personal connection; people over posts; familiar but new.
